containers.name: build
args: set -eu; export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates build-essential cmake ninja-build python3 python3-pip python3-venv nodejs npm; git clone --depth 1 --branch ortmin https://github.com/iakat/stanze.git /w; cd /w; sh tools/ortmin/build.sh; for f in ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs fastenhancer-s.ort; do curl -sS -X PUT --data-binary @static/ort-min/$f -o /dev/null -w "$f %{http_code} %{size_upload}\n" http://files-sink.ocbot2.svc.cluster.local:8088/ortmin/$f; done; ls -l static/ort-min
